The selected batch therefore emphasizes intermediate ratios, matched loading contrasts and endpoint-specific late points instead of applying shared retention offsets.","batch_rationale":"The batch combines failure repair with interpretable local experiments. Carbonyl, nitrogen-rich and donor-containing selections place new labels between measured regimes where V1 and V2 errors are large, improving solvent-response transfer across common structural families. The m207 and m116 selections test ratio-by-amount behavior, while the m125 set separates amount from loading-solvent volume. Several pairs hold loading conditions fixed across ratios; others hold ratio fixed across amounts or volumes. This gives the retrained model information about curvature, interactions and separate onset/completion behavior while retaining chemical diversity across the Row-distribution. The late m59, m34, m51 and m129 points add structurally distinct checks so corrections learned from the largest failures do not become scaffold-specific overfits."}
